title: Every animal wears a mark: the bed with and without life marks
question: Can you find every animal at play zoom now, and is a 3x3 square in the colony colour the right marker, or should it be bigger, a ring, or off by default?
context_md:
Same seed, same default bed, three stops (frames 0, 2400, 12000, top to bottom). B adds a full-replace 3x3 mark over every living animal in the colour it already wears under ANIMALS WEAR. Shipped ON, key Y toggles, and a LIFE MARKS row sits on the ANTS page. Cost measured at 0.0013 ms per drawn frame at 59 animals; it never runs per simulated tick. A single-pixel mark was tried first and did not read against the soil.

This is the harness bed (52 ants dropped on 8 seedlings at frame 0), not a played bed; the 4 survivors at frame 12000 are that bed's starvation, not the marks.

items.label: B: life marks on
items.caption: 3x3 mark per living animal, colony colour
